rubric.4: Application persists all user accounts and all stored documents using durable, database-backed storage.
rubric.5: Application allows users to upload files into the document knowledge base.
rubric.6: Application allows users to update or replace existing uploaded documents.
rubric.7: Application integrates Chroma as the vector database for document storage.
rubric.8: Application embeds and indexes all documents for retrieval within the vector store.
rubric.9: Application provides an AI chat interface that allows users to send questions to the assistant.
rubric.10: Application generates AI responses using retrieval-augmented generation that incorporates relevant documents.
rubric.11: Application integrates web search to supplement retrieval when generating answers.
rubric.12: Application displays a persistent conversation history for each user.
rubric.13: Application persists all chat logs so users can revisit prior conversations.
rubric.14: Application handles all uploaded legal documents securely to protect sensitive information.
rubric.15: Application implements voice dictation functionality that allows users to record spoken questions through a microphone control in the chat interface.
rubric.16: Application automatically transcribes recorded speech into text and places it into the chat input box.
rubric.17: Application allows users to review and edit transcribed text before sending it as a message.
rubric.18: Application ensures transcription quality is sufficient to handle common legal terminology accurately.
rubric.19: Application supports @-referencing of documents using an @-style syntax.
rubric.20: Application retrieves any @-referenced document or set of documents from the vector store in addition to other retrieved materials.
rubric.21: Application passes the content and metadata of all @-referenced documents to the AI assistant as high-priority context during response generation.
rubric.22: Application ensures the AI assistant explicitly cites or references the @-mentioned documents in its response when appropriate, including summarizing or quoting key sections within permissible limits.
